tc848_rationale: Re-keyed by TC-848 (G3), 2026-11-19, under operator decision DG-1, for the cohort-C1 python pilots whose default sample (3 titled chunks each, keyed by chunk title and frame) changed when their chunks were regenerated: 3d, barcode, email, html, note, page, pdf, slides and words (cells and tex keep their keys). 21 old keys were replaced by 21 new keys, so every pilot still records exactly 3 failing sampled cases. Ranking churn from regenerated chunk text; no previously fine symbol lost a non-prefix probe. Evidence: every title of every cohort pilot, wrapped in all 12 frames, was run through lookup() against the old (1b52191e) and the new committed generations: every doc case fails in both (48 of 48 per pilot, 60 of 60 for tex) and every example case fails in both (pdf 227 of 228 in both), so the failure rate is unchanged and no case that passed before fails now. strict stays false; no non-cohort entry changed.
tc849_rationale: Re-recorded by TC-849 (G3), 2026-11-19, under operator decision DG-1 (second re-record, after the authored pdf/net and 3d/net examples were added), for the six cohort-C2 .NET pilots pdf, slides, words, cells, email and 3d after their regeneration with 4096-dim vectors, one-chunk examples and honest verification (README examples whose run failed or produced no output are no longer published; authored examples now carry the run). The default sample draws 3 of each pilot's own doc and example titles with a fixed seed, so regenerated chunks draw different titles: ranking churn of an all-failing probe, not a lost answer. Evidence: every title x all twelve frames (936 old, 924 new cases over the six pilots) was run through lookup against the old (HEAD) and the new committed generations: 0 of the 732 title/frame cases present on both sides passed before and fail now, 0 failed before and pass now, and 0 of the 936 old and 0 of the 924 new cases pass at all (this probe fails for every sampled title of every .NET pilot, before and after). Default-sample entries recorded here, added/removed per pilot: cells +1/-1; email +2/-2; pdf +0/-0; slides +3/-3; words +0/-0; 3d +3/-3 (9 added, 9 removed, 97 -> 97 entries). The pdf__net literal LONGQ-001 entry, imaging__net and every non-cohort pilot entry are unchanged; strict stays false as before.
tc850_rationale: Re-recorded by TC-850 (G3), 2026-11-20, under operator decision DG-1, for the four cohort-C3 Java pilots pdf, slides, cells and 3d after their regeneration with 4096-dim vectors, enum constant values, one-chunk examples and honest verification (README examples whose run failed or produced no output are no longer published; the slides/java clone example is authored). The default sample draws 3 of each pilot's own doc and example titles with a fixed seed, so regenerated chunks draw different titles: ranking churn of an all-failing probe, not a lost answer. Evidence: every title x all twelve frames (660 old, 588 new cases over the four pilots) was run through lookup against the old (HEAD) and the new committed generations: 0 of the 432 title/frame cases present on both sides passed before and fail now, 0 failed before and pass now, and 0 of the 660 old and 0 of the 588 new cases pass at all (this probe fails for every sampled title of every Java pilot, before and after). Default-sample entries recorded here, added/removed per pilot: 3d +2/-2; cells +1/-1; pdf +3/-3; slides +3/-3 (9 added, 9 removed, 97 -> 97 entries). The pdf__net literal LONGQ-001 entry, imaging__net and every non-cohort pilot entry are unchanged; strict stays false as before.
